responsibility: Supplies the declarative extension-definition table for T-Head vendor extensions used by the RISC-V backend’s common extension infrastructure. It enumerates XThead* subextensions with their canonical names, human-readable full names, supported versions, flag grouping, and feature-bit placeholders, allowing the shared extension generators and option logic to expose T-Head features such as XTheadBa/Bb/Bs, memidx/mempair, sync, CMO, and XTheadVector consistently with standard extensions.
